conclusion: The exact original get_factory_task call used only taskId and that value equals the UUID in its latest owned startup fixture's user request. The fixture request names an existing Issue and asks dispatch_run. This is Issue ID / Factory task ID confusion in this original model call; the failure is not evidence of an Agent start or provider timeout.
limitations: No raw user text, tool input/output, token, connection credential, email or prompt is returned.
The query establishes equality against the persisted original request, not what objects existed before cleanup.
No Factory task is pre-created, no principal is changed, and no model request is retried.
No claim that a future Codex call will choose dispatch_run correctly.
